transcript.speaker: Alice Johnson
transcript.text: Let's begin the post-mortem for yesterday's outage. Charlie, can you walk us through the timeline?

transcript.speaker: Charlie Davis
transcript.text: At 2 PM, we saw a massive spike in database connections, which eventually starved the connection pool.

transcript.speaker: Charlie Davis
transcript.text: The API started returning 500s. We identified a misconfigured cron job that was spawning too many worker threads.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Lee
transcript.text: I was on call. It took us about 30 minutes to pinpoint the cron job.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Lee
transcript.text: Once we killed it, the system recovered immediately. The downtime cost us around $15,000 in lost transactions.

transcript.speaker: Alice Johnson
transcript.text: That's a significant impact. We need better alerting on connection pool saturation.

transcript.speaker: Alice Johnson
transcript.text: Hannah, can you take the action item to set up DataDog alerts for when the connection pool hits 80% capacity?

transcript.speaker: Hannah Lee
transcript.text: Yes, I can do that today. I'll also add a runbook entry for this specific scenario.

transcript.speaker: Charlie Davis
transcript.text: I'll take the action to fix the cron job configuration so it enforces a strict concurrency limit.

transcript.speaker: Charlie Davis
transcript.text: We should also review all other cron jobs to ensure they follow this pattern. I will do that tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Alice Johnson
transcript.text: Is there any risk of data corruption from the dropped connections?

transcript.speaker: Hannah Lee
transcript.text: We ran a full integrity check this morning. 100% of the transactions were either completed or safely rolled back.

transcript.speaker: Alice Johnson
transcript.text: That's a relief. Let's make sure these action items are done by the end of the sprint.

transcript.speaker: Alice Johnson
transcript.text: Thanks for the quick response during the incident, team. We learned a valuable lesson here.

transcript.speaker: Charlie Davis
transcript.text: Agreed. See you all at the next standup.

summary.overview_text: Post-mortem for the recent outage caused by a misconfigured cron job exhausting the database connection pool. The team resolved the issue in 30 minutes. Action items include setting up new connection pool alerts, updating the runbook, and fixing the cron job concurrency limits.

action_items.text: Set up DataDog alerts for connection pool > 80%
Add runbook entry for connection pool exhaustion
Audit other cron jobs for concurrency limits tomorrow
